entries.title: The first entry
entries.body:
This is where it starts. Delete this text and write about today, or about the first time you met — whatever feels right.

You can add as many paragraphs as you want, just leave a blank line between them.

entries.body: You can backdate entries too — just change the date above. Entries are sorted newest first automatically.
